iti24:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti24:2.1: “Monks, if a single person were to wander & transmigrate on for an eon, he/she would leave behind a chain of bones, a pile of bones, a heap of bones, as large as this Mount Vepulla, if there were someone to collect them and the collection were not destroyed.”
iti24:3.1:
The accumulation
of a single person’s
bones for an eon
iti24:3.3:
would be a heap
on a par with the mountain,
iti24:4.3: to the north of Vulture Peak
iti24:4.4:
in the mountain-ring
of the Magadhans.)
iti24:5.1:
But when that person sees
with right discernment
iti24:5.6: the way to the stilling of stress–
iti24:6.1:
having wandered on
seven times at most,
iti24:6.3:
with the ending of all fetters,
he makes an end
of stress.
